seoIntro.title: Find Location by Phone Number Instantly — Track Anyone, Anywhere
seoIntro.lede: Tracify is a real-time phone tracker that lets you track anyone, anywhere by phone number — with the recipient's consent, no app install required. Whether you want to find someone's location right now, track someone by phone number for peace of mind, or locate a lost phone after misplacing it at the airport, Tracify closes the gap in under 60 seconds.
seoIntro.body: Here's how our phone number tracker works: enter the number you want to locate, write a short message, and Tracify delivers a one-tap consent link by SMS. The moment the recipient approves, their real-time GPS location appears on your dashboard — precise enough to see street-level detail. The same instant phone location flow works on every iPhone, every Android, and every mobile carrier worldwide. No jailbreak, no sideloading, no spyware. Most so-called phone trackers online are scams or stalkerware — Tracify is different because it's consent-based, which makes it fully legal under GDPR, CCPA, and PECR. You get the same track-anyone-anywhere capability users demand — without the legal risk or ethical compromise. If you need to find location by phone number instantly, locate anyone by phone number, or simply find a lost phone by number, Tracify is the fastest, safest, most honest option on the market.

howItWorksPage.subtitle: Locate any phone worldwide with consent-based SMS tracking — three simple steps, no installation, no guesswork.
howItWorksPage.s1Title: The Tracify method in plain English
howItWorksPage.s1P1: Tracify is a phone tracker by number that works in every country on every mobile network. Unlike spyware tools that require physical access to a device, Tracify uses a privacy-first, consent-based approach: we send a custom SMS to the target number, the recipient agrees to share their location with one tap, and you get precise GPS coordinates in your dashboard.
howItWorksPage.s1P2: This means Tracify is legal to use anywhere in the world — as long as the recipient gives consent by responding to the SMS. No app installation. No rooting or jailbreaking. No background agents. Just a number, a message, and a location.
howItWorksPage.step1P: Type the phone number you want to locate and customise the SMS message the recipient will see. You can explain why you're asking — many users write a short reassurance like "Hey, it's Mum — can you share your location?"
howItWorksPage.step2P: Tracify delivers your custom message to the target number. The recipient sees the sender's name you chose, reads your message, and decides whether to share their location. If they agree, they tap a single link to approve the request.
howItWorksPage.step3P: The moment consent is given, the exact GPS coordinates appear in your dashboard on an interactive map. You can see where the phone is — down to street level — and return to check fresh locations whenever the recipient approves follow-up pings.
howItWorksPage.s3Li1: Consent-based: tracking happens only when the recipient agrees — so Tracify never violates privacy laws.
howItWorksPage.s3Li2: Universal coverage: works on iOS, Android, GSM, CDMA, LTE, and 5G, across every country where mobile networks exist.
howItWorksPage.s3Li3: No installation: nothing to install on your device or the target device. Everything runs from the Tracify web dashboard.
howItWorksPage.s3Li4: Real-time GPS: once consent is given, you get precise GPS coordinates — not triangulated guesses.
howItWorksPage.s3Li5: Transparent pricing: 24-hour full-access trial for just $1.47, then $30 per month. Cancel any time in one click.
howItWorksPage.s4P: People use Tracify to reconnect with loved ones on holiday, co-parent across distance, check on elderly family members, coordinate with colleagues in the field, and quickly locate a lost phone when other options have failed. The common thread: they all want a simple, legal, privacy-respecting way to know where a phone is — right now.
howItWorksPage.s5P: Start your 24-hour trial for $1.47 and locate the first phone in under two minutes. If it's not for you, cancel any time — no questions asked.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Here you can find all the answers to the questions we are most often asked about our mobile geolocation service, Tracify.
faq.a1: Tracify is a mobile geolocation service that allows you to locate any phone number worldwide. Our service works by sending an SMS to the target phone requesting location sharing consent. Once consent is given, you receive the precise GPS coordinates.
faq.q2: Is it even legal to use the Tracify phone number tracker?
faq.a2: Yes, Tracify is completely legal because it requires explicit consent from the person being tracked. The recipient must actively agree to share their location by responding to the SMS request. We comply with all privacy regulations and data protection laws.
faq.a3: Tracify supports all major mobile networks worldwide. Whether the target phone uses GSM, CDMA, LTE, or 5G networks, our service can send location requests to any valid phone number.
faq.q4: Can I track the location of the phone number if I don't know its model?
faq.a4: Absolutely! You don't need to know the phone model, manufacturer, or operating system. All you need is the phone number. Our system automatically handles all the technical details regardless of the device type.
faq.q5: Does Tracify support both iOS and Android operated mobile devices?
faq.a5: Yes, Tracify works with both iOS (iPhone) and Android devices. Our SMS-based location request system is compatible with any smartphone that can receive text messages and has location services available.
faq.q6: How fast can Tracify find the location of a phone number?
faq.a6: Once the SMS recipient consents to share their location, you'll receive the coordinates almost instantly. The total time depends on how quickly the recipient responds to the location request.
faq.q7: How to track a phone number without physical access to the target device?
faq.a7: Simply enter the phone number in our system, customize your message, and we'll send an SMS requesting location consent. Everything is done remotely - no physical access to the target device is ever required.
faq.q8: Can I track someone by cell phone number?
faq.a8: Yes, but only with their explicit consent. Tracify sends a location request via SMS, and tracking only occurs when the recipient agrees to share their location. This ensures privacy and legal compliance.

faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about tracking a phone by number with Tracify — how it works, whether it's legal, what devices we support, and how our pricing works.
faqPage.a1: Tracify is a phone tracker by number — a web-based service that locates any mobile phone worldwide using only its phone number. It works by sending a consent-based SMS to the target phone. Once the recipient agrees to share their location, you receive the precise GPS coordinates in your Tracify dashboard.
faqPage.q2: Is it legal to use Tracify?
faqPage.a2: Yes. Tracify is completely legal because every tracking request requires explicit consent from the person being tracked. The recipient must actively agree to share their location by responding to the SMS. We comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations.
faqPage.q3: Which carriers and networks does Tracify support?
faqPage.a3: Tracify supports every major mobile carrier worldwide. Whether the target phone uses GSM, CDMA, LTE, 4G, or 5G, our service can deliver a location request to any valid phone number in any country.
faqPage.q4: Do I need to know the phone model?
faqPage.a4: No. All you need is the phone number. You don't need to know the make, model, operating system, or carrier. Tracify handles all the technical details automatically.
faqPage.q5: Does Tracify support iOS and Android?
faqPage.a5: Yes. Tracify works with both iOS (iPhone) and Android devices. Our SMS-based consent system works with any smartphone that can receive text messages and has location services enabled.
faqPage.q6: How fast does Tracify return a location?
faqPage.a6: As soon as the SMS recipient taps the consent link, you'll see the GPS coordinates almost instantly in your dashboard. Total time depends on how quickly the recipient responds to the request.
faqPage.q7: Do I need physical access to the target phone?
faqPage.a7: Never. Tracify is 100% remote. There's nothing to install on your device or the target's device. You just enter the phone number, we send the SMS, and the recipient chooses whether to share their location.
faqPage.q8: Can I track a phone number's location without installing an app?
faqPage.a8: Yes. Tracify is a no-installation phone tracker. You don't install anything on your device or the target's device. Everything happens through a standard SMS link and a web dashboard, so you can find a location by phone number from any browser on iOS, Android, Windows, or Mac.
faqPage.q9: How do I locate a phone by number anonymously?
faqPage.a9: Tracify lets you set a custom sender name on every request, so the recipient never sees "Tracify" — they only see the name and message you choose. Combined with our encrypted dashboard, this makes Tracify an effectively anonymous phone tracker: the recipient chooses to share their location, but they never learn which service processed the request.
faqPage.q10: Can I track a phone that is turned off?
faqPage.a10: No. A phone must be switched on and connected to a mobile network to receive the consent SMS. If the device is off, airplane mode, or out of signal, the request waits in the carrier queue and delivers as soon as the phone reconnects. You'll be notified in your dashboard the moment the location is shared.
faqPage.q11: How accurate is phone tracking by number?
faqPage.a11: Once the recipient approves the request, Tracify returns the same real-time GPS coordinates the phone uses for Google Maps or Apple Maps — typically accurate to within 5-15 meters outdoors. Indoor accuracy depends on Wi-Fi and cell-tower triangulation, usually within 20-50 meters.
faqPage.q12: Can I track a phone by IMEI number?
faqPage.a12: Tracify uses the phone number, not the IMEI. IMEI tracking generally requires carrier or law-enforcement cooperation and is not available to consumers. Our consent-based SMS system is designed to be the fastest, safest legal way for an individual to locate a phone by number.
faqPage.q13: Can I track someone without their knowledge?
faqPage.a13: No. Tracify is a consent-based service and will always notify the recipient that their location is being requested. The recipient must actively tap a link to share their location. This is what keeps Tracify legal and ethical.
faqPage.a14: Tracify offers a 24-hour full-access trial for just $1.47. After the trial, your subscription automatically renews at $30 per month. You can cancel at any time from your account page or by contacting our support team.
faqPage.q15: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqPage.a15: We accept every major credit and debit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) and common digital wallets through our payment processor, Stripe. Payments are processed securely and we never store raw card data on our servers.
faqPage.q16: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqPage.a16: Cancellation is one click. Visit the Cancel Subscription page, confirm your email, and your billing will stop immediately at the end of the current period. No retention forms, no phone calls.
faqPage.a17: If Tracify doesn't work for you during the trial, you can cancel immediately and you won't be charged the monthly fee. For monthly subscribers, contact support within 7 days of a charge to discuss a refund.
faqPage.q18: What data does Tracify collect about me?
faqPage.a18: Only what's required to run your account: email, country, billing records, and the phone numbers you submit for tracking. We don't sell data and we don't run third-party ad trackers on our service. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
faqPage.a19: Yes. All traffic between your browser and Tracify is encrypted with TLS. Data at rest is encrypted and stored with a tier-1 cloud provider. Payment details never touch our servers — they're handled directly by Stripe.
faqPage.q20: Will the person I'm tracking know who sent the SMS?
faqPage.a20: You can set the sender name on each request. The recipient sees that name and your custom message. Tracify itself remains confidential from the recipient — they only see what you choose to show them.
faqPage.q21: What if the recipient ignores the SMS?
faqPage.a21: If the recipient doesn't tap the consent link, no location is shared. You can re-send the request or customise a new message. Tracking only ever happens after active consent.
faqPage.q22: My dashboard says the request failed. What happened?
faqPage.a22: Failed requests usually mean the number is invalid, the phone is off, or the carrier blocked the international SMS. Check the number format (include country code) and try again. If the issue persists, contact support.
faqPage.q23: Can I still use Tracify if the target phone is abroad?
faqPage.a23: Yes. Tracify works in every country where mobile networks exist. International phone numbers work exactly like domestic ones — as long as you include the correct country code.
